summary: Use transferred self-pidfds for unattached gates and retire attached trees before reaping (unit 9c fix 1)

rules.detail: INACTIVE. Non-attached gated abort signals only its owned pidfd and reaps. Attached cancellation fences release, runs the common kill-empty-sample-remove retirement, then reaps; no direct holder signal.

compatibility.detail: Command spawn can internally reap before returning Child. The pre_exec child opens its own pidfd and transfers it over a private socket before readiness, using raw async-signal-safe syscalls. Parent never opens a pidfd from the published PID. Transfer failure aborts without exec.

manual.detail: Added descriptor-transfer and failure tests, ignored native attached/unattached and failed-publication fixtures, and fake-tree attached retry coverage. Cargo and native execution not run.

recovery.detail: Attached release stays fenced across retirement failure. Retry re-enters the uniform retirement path and cannot release or relaunch the child.
